transforms.code:
# Property binding + transform, never runScript ARGS: a container passed
	# as a runScript arg arrives as a Perspective ImmutableMap that
	# extractQualifiedValues cannot unwrap, and the JSON compare then misfires
	# -- 'unsaved changes' with nothing edited (Plant Hierarchy, 2026-10-23).
	s = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(value) or {}
	toJson = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson
	return toJson(s.get("editDraft")) != toJson(s.get("selected"))

customMethods.name: load
customMethods.script:
# Named pack-outs (0136): per method, the part's DEFAULT pack-out is loaded into
	# the form; the buttons above it load any other one. No terminal here: the Config
	# Tool edits pack-outs, it never selects what a station runs.
	itemId = self.view.params.value or 0
	packOuts = BlueRidge.Parts.ContainerConfig.listForItem(itemId)
	blocks = BlueRidge.Parts.PackOutPopup.draftForItem(itemId, packOuts)
	self.view.custom.packOuts = packOuts
	self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
	self.view.custom.state = {"selected": blocks, "editDraft": system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(blocks))}
